text:
TRUMP CANCELS, THEN UN-CANCELS 5,000 TROOPS TO POLAND — IMPERIAL WHIPLASH

Trump announced 5,000 soldiers to Poland on May 21, weeks after canceling the same deployment. Why the reversal? "I'm proud to support" Polish president Nawrocki — personal friendship driving military strategy.

Meanwhile, the Pentagon is pulling 5,000 soldiers out of Germany after Merz criticized the US over Iran. The Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed. The world's largest military now redeploys based on who flatters Trump the most.

DIALOGUE, NOT REPRESSION — 74,000 TEACHER TRANSFERS RESOLVED IN CNTE TALKS

The SEP has held over 140 meetings with the CNTE in the past year, resolving 74,000 workplace transfers nationwide with new transparent criteria prioritizing seniority. Education Secretary Mario Delgado reaffirmed commitment to eliminating USICAMM entirely — the neoliberal teacher evaluation system imposed under Peña Nieto.

"Pressure and complaints about USICAMM decreased significantly," Delgado said. Interior Ministry actively involved in ongoing talks with CNTE sections in Chiapas, Oaxaca, Zacatecas, and Guerrero.

NAVY DISMANTLES THREE METH LABS IN SINALOA — 4,000 KG SEIZED

Federal forces (Navy + FGR) located and disabled three clandestine synthetic drug labs across two Sinaloa municipalities. Combined seizure: 4,000 kg methamphetamine, 200 kg more in drying stage, plus thousands of liters of precursor chemicals including toluene, acetic acid, and caustic soda.

Estimated financial loss to criminal organizations: over 923 million pesos. All materials disabled and transferred to the Public Ministry.

CHIHUAHUA-TEXAS AGREEMENT "UNUSUAL" — SHEINBAUM ORDERS SOVEREIGNTY REVIEW

Sheinbaum flagged a 2022 agreement between Chihuahua governor Maru Campos and Texas governor Abbott covering intelligence exchange and drug trafficking coordination. "Está raro," she said — the agreement invades federal powers and bypasses the Foreign Ministry.

Under Mexican law, any collaboration mechanism with a foreign government must go through the SRE. A state governor signing security deals with a US state is unconstitutional. Same governor now facing impeachment for letting CIA agents operate armed on Mexican soil.

ANTI-NARCO CANDIDATE SCREENING HITS CONGRESS — INE VERIFICATION COMMISSION FOR 2027

Sheinbaum's initiative to screen political candidates for organized crime ties just landed in Congress ahead of an extraordinary session starting May 26. The reform creates a Verification Commission within the INE, coordinating with security, intelligence, and financial agencies to vet candidates before the 2027 elections.

Not mandatory — a preventive tool. Parties submit lists voluntarily, with express consent required. Safeguards protect presumption of innocence.

Four electoral reforms expected to pass before June 1. Morena applauds.

MEXICO'S ECONOMY REBOUNDS IN MARCH — IGAE UP 1.4%, AGRICULTURE SURGES

INEGI's IGAE for March shows Mexico's economy grew 1.4% year-over-year and 0.5% month-over-month — bouncing back from February's contraction.

Agriculture led at +4.5% monthly growth. Services expanded 2.8% annually. Q1 GDP was revised from -0.8% to -0.6% — better than expected.

Manufacturing still drags at -1.3% annual from tariff effects, but agriculture and services are carrying the economy through Trump's trade war turbulence.

APACHE CHIRICAHUA — WE NEVER CEASED EXISTING — 130 YEARS OF DENIAL

The Chiricahua Apache Tribal Council submitted a formal demand to Chihuahua's Congress: halt voting on initiatives 626 and 636 that would reduce their recognition to a merely folkloric act.

On May 19, legislators stripped the original proposal to modify Article 8 of Chihuahua's Constitution. No public consultations held, no interpreters provided — violating ILO Convention 169.

The community rejected the imposed term N'dee/N'nee/Ndé and referenced 19th-century blood contracts — exterminationist policies. They demand truth, justice, and reparations. Not folklore.

The Apache Chiricahua people never ceased existing.

TRIQUI LEADER SNATCHED FROM HOME WITHOUT WARRANT — HAS IACHR PROTECTION

Macario García Merino — professor, activist, and leader of MULTI representing displaced Triqui families from Tierra Blanca Copala — was pulled from his home on May 15 while eating breakfast with his family, including minors and a disabled person.

Oaxaca state police entered without a judicial warrant, struck him, and transferred him to an unmarked vehicle with unidentified armed men.

Cedhapi documented arbitrary detention, torture, and forced disappearance. García holds protective measure MC-279-22 from the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights. The human rights center says the detention reflects political debts in Governor Salomón Jara's administration — criminalizing the representation of displaced indigenous communities.

SHEINBAUM — NARCOTRAFFICKING WAS ALWAYS A PRETEXT FOR US INTERVENTION

At the mañanera, Sheinbaum laid out the historical pattern: the US has used drug trafficking as cover for political meddling across Latin America for decades.

She cited Evo Morales — an indigenous leader accused of narco ties because he came from a coca-producing region. Coca is not cocaine. Under Morales, Bolivia saw economic growth, poverty reduction, and strengthened resource sovereignty.

She referenced Miguel de la Madrid's own memoirs documenting the same US pattern against Mexico. Context: the DOJ just indicted 94-year-old Raúl Castro on drug charges. When the empire runs out of new tricks, it recycles the old ones.

FLOTILLA WOMEN ARRIVE IN MEXICO — REPORT TORTURE BY ISRAELI FORCES

Dr. Violeta Núñez Rodríguez and activist Sol González Eguía landed at Mexico City's airport today after being expelled by Israel from the Global Sumud Flotilla.

Their testimony: kidnapped in international waters, held on a prison ship for three days, then transferred to a penitentiary. Among 500 activists detained, 35 suffered fractures — ribs, legs, shoulders, arms. At least 15 reported sexual assault. Five received injections of unidentified substances. Fifty were hospitalized.

They applied humiliating treatment that violates human dignity. Both are requesting a meeting with President Sheinbaum to demand Mexico sever diplomatic relations with the Netanyahu government.
